description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for git notes and commit history operations, including setup, note addition, verification, and various test scenarios with different fanout directory structures.

methods.name: start_note_commit
methods.description: Initializes a commit with notes referencing ref 'refs/notes/commits' and sets the committer information.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies that the notes for commits match the expected pattern by examining git log output.

methods.name: test_sha1_based
methods.description: Creates a series of commits with notes based on SHA1 hash transformation rules.

methods.name: test_same_notes
methods.description: Creates commits where multiple references point to the same note data.

methods.name: verify_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Checks that the notes for commits contain concatenated content from multiple notes.
